sponsored.t: Authorizes Sgt. Bethany Kidd to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Sgt. Bethany Kidd to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan for service with the Seneca Falls Police Department.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to receive certain service credit under a twenty year retirement plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Lt. Thomas Cleere to change his service credit from the improved career retirement plan to a 20 year retirement plan.

sponsored.t: Designates uniformed marine patrol officers as peace officers in the county of Seneca
sponsored.sum: Designates uniformed marine patrol officers appointed by the sheriff of Seneca county as peace officers in the county of Seneca.

sponsored.t: Relates to the reporting and remediation of certain sites following municipal notification to the department of environmental conservation
sponsored.sum: Requires a municipality to notify the department of environmental conservation about certain sites containing illegal or hazardous substances; requires the department of environmental conservation to notify the United States environmental protection agency and create a remediation plan for the affected site.

sponsored.t: Relates to legalizing and validating certain actions taken by the town of Aurelius in apportioning water district costs
sponsored.sum: Legalizes and validates the establishment of a unit-based tax levy by the town of Aurelius in apportioning certain water district costs in violation of current town law.

sponsored.t: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system to the Gorham Pageant of Bands
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of the state highway system in the town of Gorham, county of Ontario, to the Gorham Pageant of Bands.

sponsored.t: Relates to free use of state park pavilions by recognized veterans' organization
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Grants recognized veterans' organizations free use of pavilions at state parks, other state recreational facilities, and historic sites.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring health care facilities to report incidents of a sexual offense to the departments of both health and education
sponsored.sum: Requires health care facilities to report incidents of a sexual offense to the departments of health and education.

sponsored.t: Authorizes distinctive license plates for supporters of the conservation of the Seneca white deer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes distinctive license plates for supporters of the conservation of the Seneca white deer; establishes the New York state "preserve the Seneca white deer fund".

sponsored.t: Relates to school suspension
sponsored.sum: Provides that where a pupil may be considered a dangerous threat to themself or others, such pupil may be suspended for no more than ten days prior to a hearing taking place to allow the school to have adequate time to make an evaluation on the pupil's mental health, which may include a psychiatric evaluation, and the risk of danger to others and to consult with law enforcement.

sponsored.t: Requires businesses who offer delivery services to provide markings for their vehicles and drivers
sponsored.sum: Requires businesses who offer delivery services to provide markings for their vehicles and drivers; provides penalties for failing to do so.

sponsored.t: Creates a series of distinctive license plates for law enforcement officers who were wounded in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Creates a series of distinctive license plates for law enforcement officers who were wounded in the line of duty or the spouse of such, which shall bear the words "Wounded in the Line of Duty"; includes the New York state sheriff's association, New York state association of chiefs of police, police benevolent association of the New York state troopers, the New York state police benevolent association, and the New York city police benevolent association; provides that proceeds from the service charge shall be used for a fund to assist wounded/fallen officers and their families.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing the names of peace officers slain in the line of duty in the state of New York to be added to the police officers memorial
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the division of criminal justice services to add to the police officers memorial the names of peace officers of the state of New York who are slain in the line of duty.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain military personnel to get married within twenty-four hours of receiving a marriage license
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain military personnel who are scheduled to be deployed within thirty days to get married within twenty-four hours of receiving a marriage license.

sponsored.t: Relates to courthouse facility dogs for witnesses
sponsored.sum: Authorizes courts to exercise discretion permitting a courthouse facility dog for use by witnesses to be used in any judicial proceeding; provides that courts with an available courthouse facility dog must allow a witness under eighteen years of age, or who has a developmental disability, to use a courthouse facility dog to accompany such person while testifying in court; allows any witness who does not meet the criteria of being under eighteen years of age or having a developmental disability to use a courthouse facility dog, if available, to accompany them while testifying in court; defines terms; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relating to selectively cutting timber
sponsored.sum: Relates to selectively cutting timber and exclusion of current best management practices from regulated activities.

sponsored.t: Establishes the GrowNY pilot program, an economic gardening pilot program within the department of economic development
sponsored.sum: Establishes the GrowNY pilot program, an economic gardening pilot program within the department of economic development to stimulate investment in the state economy by providing technical assistance for expanding businesses in the state.

sponsored.t: Creates the New York state veterans remembrance license plate
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York state veterans remembrance license plate; provides that any proceeds shall go to the credit of the veterans remembrance and cemetery maintenance operation fund.

sponsored.t: Requires the county seat in Seneca county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting
sponsored.sum: Requires the county seat in Seneca county to have at least one polling place designated for early voting.

sponsored.t: Requires appointees of the minority leader of the senate and the minority leader of the assembly to be included in all legislatively enacted workgroups, task forces, commissions, and committees
sponsored.sum: Requires proportionally equivalent appointees of both the majority and minority houses of the legislature in all legislatively enacted workgroups, task forces, commissions, councils, advisory boards, committees and any other legislatively enacted and appointed groups or workgroups; requires that the number of appointees by the legislature shall be proportionally equivalent to the number of appointees by the governor.

sponsored.t: Relates to the employee training incentive program
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of the credit of eligible training costs from fifty percent to seventy percent for the employee training incentive program.

sponsored.t: Requires all goods, except food, sold at retail in state parks, recreational facilities and historic sites to be produced in the United States
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Requires all goods, except food, sold at retail in state parks, recreational facilities and historic sites to be produced in the United States.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a service center for independent living to be located in the county of Ontario
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring a service center for independent living to be located in the county of Ontario.

sponsored.t: Establishes the disaster-related latent damage recovery grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the disaster-related latent damage recovery grant program to repair latent damage to public infrastructure, including publicly-owned roads, bridges, drainage and flood mitigation systems, electrical and mechanical systems and communication systems, and any ancillary infrastructure necessary for the safe operation of the components thereof, where such damage was the result of a natural disaster.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "employment first choice act" to ensure that an individual with developmental disabilities in a nonintegrated setting shall have the right to remain in such a setting under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "employment first choice act" to ensure that an individual with developmental disabilities in a nonintegrated setting shall have the right to remain in such a setting under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Provides for a credit against personal income tax for volunteer firefighters who complete qualifications to become a training instructor
sponsored.sum: Provides for a credit against personal income tax for volunteer firefighters who complete qualifications to become a training instructor; provides that such credit shall be equal to the sum of five hundred dollars or the total amount of the tax owed by the taxpayer if less than five hundred dollars, whichever is lower.

sponsored.t: Relates to enhancing penalties and protecting victims of crimes of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Relates to enhancing penalties and protecting victims of crimes of domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Provides that persons arrested for domestic violence forfeit bail when violating an order of protection
sponsored.sum: Provides that persons arrested for domestic violence forfeit bail when violating an order of protection.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a contraband and drug information hotline
sponsored.sum: Creates a contraband and drug information hotline for state correctional facilities; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to limits on certain legislative leader positions
sponsored.sum: Limits the time a legislator may serve as a legislative leader to four consecutive two year terms.

sponsored.t: Relates to the ability for school districts to implement telehealth school-based mental health clinics
sponsored.sum: Grants school districts the ability to implement telehealth school-based mental health clinics; establishes the student mental telehealth reimbursement fund; relates to funding the student mental telehealth reimbursement fund.

sponsored.t: Increases from 50 to 100 acres, the acreage of farm woodland that qualifies as land used in agricultural production for agricultural assessment purposes
sponsored.sum: Increases from 50 to 100 acres, the acreage of farm woodland that qualifies as land used in agricultural production for agricultural assessment purposes.

sponsored.t: Requires state and county incarcerated individuals to make medical co-payments
sponsored.sum: Requires a person incarcerated in state and county-owned or operated correctional facilities to make medical co-payments of seven dollars upon receipt of medical treatment; provides that an incarcerated individual shall not be refused treatment for lack of ability to pay co-payment charges; directs all moneys collected to be made available for the operation of such correctional facility.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing term limits for members of the assembly and senate of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides that members of the assembly and senate of New York shall not serve more than six two-year terms in either house.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of qualified reservation for taxation purposes
sponsored.sum: Provides that lands held by the Cayuga Indian Nation of New York shall not be considered a qualified reservation for purposes of certain tax law and real property tax law provisions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the feasibility of removing all existing 3-cable guide rails on New York roadways
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the feasibility of removing all existing 3-cable guide rails on New York roadways and replacing such guide rails with safer alternatives; requires a report to be submitted to the governor, the temporary president of the senate, the speaker of the assembly, the minority leader of the senate, and the minority leader of the assembly containing the findings and recommendations for legislative or other actions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes local municipalities and political subdivisions to have final say on if a renewable energy power plant can be sited in such municipalities or political subdivision's jurisdiction
sponsored.sum: Authorizes local municipalities and political subdivisions to have final say on if a renewable energy power plant can be sited in such municipalities' or political subdivisions' jurisdiction; establishes conflict of interest standards for approving the siting of a renewable energy power plant in a local municipality or political subdivision; requires the office of renewable energy siting and electric transmissions establish a database to collect and display host agreements and land contracts for renewable energy power plants; establishes contract standards concerning the forfeiture of mineral rights for the siting of renewable energy power plants; regulates the conduct of businesses engaged…

sponsored.t: Creates the New York state commission on government efficiency
sponsored.sum: Creates the New York state commission on government efficiency to examine state spending, identify unnecessary and wasteful spending and create a report of recommendations of spending items that can be eliminated by New York state.

sponsored.t: Provides schools the option to operate one hundred eighty days of instruction or the equivalent number of hours of pupil instruction
sponsored.sum: Provides schools the option to operate one hundred eighty days of instruction or the equivalent number of hours of pupil instruction.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain required disclosures upon the release of a juvenile or adolescent offender from an office of children and family services facility
sponsored.sum: Relates to the required disclosure upon the release of a juvenile or adolescent offender from the custody of the office of children and family services of certain records that are necessary to ascertain the nature of such offender's conviction and would be beneficial in identifying and mitigating any risk that such offender could pose if released.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale or lease of any property in the state to the People's Republic of China or the Chinese communist party
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or lease of any property in the state to the People's Republic of China or the Chinese communist party.

sponsored.t: Extends the additional one percent sales and use tax for Chenango county
sponsored.sum: Extends the additional one percent sales and use tax for Chenango county.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church
sponsored.sum: Exempts certain property from the prohibition of alcohol sales within a certain distance from a church for a certain premises located in the county of Ontario.

sponsored.t: Dedicating a portion of the state highway system to TSgt Kory Wade
sponsored.sum: Dedicates a portion of New York state route 21 to TSgt Kory Wade.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization for the county of Seneca to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the expiration of the authorization for the county of Seneca to impose an additional one percent sales and compensating use tax for two years.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the authorization for Ontario county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization for Ontario county to impose additional rates of sales and compensating use taxes until 2027.
